description: Search Google Contacts by name, email, or phone number. Returns matching contacts with their details.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

max_results.description: Maximum number of contacts to return (default: 10)

query.description: Search query (name, email, phone number, or company name)

name: gws-mcp__contacts_search
